title: Coordenador Comercial
description:
SOBRE A VAGA

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) Comercial com forte capacidade analítica e disciplina de execução para atuar na gestão da rotina e performance do time de vendas. Se você entende que performance vem de processo + análise + execução, e quer atuar como peça-chave no crescimento de uma operação comercial, essa vaga é para você.

Suas principais responsabilidades

  • Gerir o time comercial no dia a dia (SDRs e/ou closers)
  • Acompanhar performance individual e coletiva
  • Realizar 1:1s frequentes com foco em evolução e resultado
  • Dar feedbacks estruturados e direcionamentos claros
  • Acompanhar o funil de vendas e garantir atualização correta no CRM
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance (conversão, volume, produtividade, etc.)
  • Estruturar e atualizar relatórios e dashboards comerciais
  • Identificar desvios de resultado e apoiar na construção de planos de ação
  • Garantir execução dos processos comerciais definidos
  • Organizar e conduzir rituais de acompanhamento (pipeline, forecast, resultados)
  • Apoiar o time na priorização de atividades e oportunidades
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos processos comerciais
  • Apoiar a liderança com análises e consolidação de dados

Qualificações

Gestão de time e liderança

  • Experiência prévia com gestão de time comercial
  • Capacidade de acompanhar e desenvolver pessoas
  • Habilidade em dar feedbacks claros e frequentes
  • Perfil próximo do time, com cobrança equilibrada e foco em resultado

Capacidade analítica (principal skill)

  • Facilidade com números e leitura de indicadores
  • Capacidade de identificar padrões, desvios e oportunidades nos dados
  • Organização para estruturar e acompanhar métricas

Excel / Sheets avançado

  • Domínio de fórmulas (PROCV/XLOOKUP, SOMASES, etc.)
  • Tabelas dinâmicas
  • Construção de relatórios e controles

Execução e organização

  • Alto nível de disciplina e atenção a detalhes
  • Capacidade de acompanhar múltiplas demandas sem perder controle
  • Consistência na rotina (não depender de motivação para executar)

Mentalidade de eficiência com tecnologia (incluindo IA)

  • Interesse prático no uso de tecnologia para ganho de produtividade
  • Experiência ou curiosidade ativa no uso de IA (ex: ChatGPT, automações, etc.) para otimizar tarefas do dia a dia
  • Capacidade de aplicar IA para análise de dados, geração de insights e melhoria de processos
  • Perfil curioso, que testa novas ferramentas e busca formas mais inteligentes de executar o trabalho

Conhecimento comercial

  • Entendimento de funil de vendas
  • Familiaridade com metas, conversões e produtividade

Comunicação clara

  • Objetividade ao apresentar números e status
  • Boa interação com time comercial e liderança

Será um diferencial

  • Experiência com CRM (como Salesforce CRM)
  • Vivência em operações de vendas B2B ou SaaS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Experiência prévia em áreas comerciais.
  • Experiência utilizando IA no contexto profissional (análises, automações, produtividade)

A Sondotécnica hoje é líder em consultoria de engenharia no Brasil, com mais de 3 mil projetos executados e mais de 400 clientes atendidos. Hoje, a Sondotécnica oferece sua expertise para empreendimentos nos setores de: – Transporte – Saneamento – Habitação – Urbanização – Energia – Indústria – Meio Ambiente – Irrigação.

Presencial - Botafogo.

Descrição da vaga

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up‑to‑date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety‑critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.

Key Competencies:

  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi‑disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem‑Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degreeis mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you!

description:
Contexte et environnement

A posição atua no mercado brasileiro, caracterizado por um ambiente jurídico e regulatório complexo e em constante evolução. O cargo exige interação e colaboração frequentes com uma ampla gama de partes internas e externas, incluindo clientes internos, escritórios de advocacia, associações do setor, parceiros de joint ventures, fornecedores e autoridades governamentais. Dada a natureza dessas interações, a função demanda fortes habilidades de negociação e a capacidade de se engajar de forma estratégica e eficaz com diferentes públicos.

Activités

O(a) funcionário(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado à proteção da integridade das pessoas, tendo em vista a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e para a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia.

Principais Atividades

  • Assessoria Jurídica Estratégica: Prestar assessoria jurídica e regulatória estratégica aos clientes internos, como equipes de Joint Ventures (JVs), em matérias administrativas, societárias, ambientais, cíveis, regulatórias de E&P e contenciosas.
  • Elaboração e Negociação Contratual: Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos comerciais, societários e operacionais relevantes, assegurando alinhamento com os modelos da TTE (quando aplicável), com os requisitos legais e com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Suporte à Governança de JVs: Apoiar as joint ventures em processos de governança, identificando riscos jurídicos, propondo medidas de mitigação e garantindo a conformidade ao longo do ciclo de vida dos projetos.
  • Relacionamento com Stakeholders e Autoridades: Atuar junto a partes externas, como autoridades governamentais, parceiros de joint ventures e associações do setor, apoiando o posicionamento jurídico da companhia e protegendo seus direitos e obrigações.
  • Resolução de Conflitos: Recomendar e implementar estratégias e conduzir processos de resolução de disputas, incluindo arbitragens de alto valor, processos administrativos e judiciais, assegurando estratégia coerente, adequada avaliação de riscos e coordenação eficaz com escritórios externos.
  • Monitoramento Legal e Regulatório e Avaliação de Impactos no Negócio: Monitorar evoluções legais e regulatórias que impactem as atividades de E&P e assessorar o negócio quanto a impactos, riscos e medidas de implementação necessárias.
  • Coordenação de Escritórios Externos: Coordenar as atividades com escritórios de advocacia externos e especialistas, garantindo consistência estratégica e alto padrão de entregáveis.
  • Representação e Atuação Institucional: Representar a companhia em comitês externos (ex.: IBP) e organizações do setor, liderando iniciativas de advocacy em matérias jurídicas e regulatórias e protegendo os ativos, a reputação e a licença social para operar no longo prazo.
  • Reporte à Gestão: Reportar de forma consistente e buscar orientação da gestão em assuntos que envolvam elevada exposição financeira ou impacto reputacional.
  • One Maestro: Atuar em conformidade com os princípios de HSSSE e One Maestro, visando proteger os ativos, a reputação e a licença de longo prazo para operar da companhia.

Responsabilités

O Especialista Jurídico Sênior prestará suporte a outras divisões da TEPBR, conforme alocação definida pelo Gerente Jurídico e pelo Diretor de Jurídico, Assuntos Regulatórios e Governança Corporativa, bem como elaborará análises sobre temas regulatórios e jurídicos de média-alta complexidade e materialidade, relacionados a atividades, ativos e projetos especiais. O cargo também apoiará a implementação e a observância das regras e regulamentos de Compliance e de HSE aplicáveis. O(a) empregado(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro, com foco na proteção da integridade das pessoas, preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para a eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia.

Experiência jurídica em nível sênior, com sólido conhecimento do arcabouço regulatório brasileiro e da prática internacional, especialmente em Leis do Petróleo e regulamentações da ANP. Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir e acompanhar incentivos fiscais aplicáveis às operações.

  • Atuar de forma integrada com Controladoria, Contabilidade, Jurídico, Financeiro e Projetos, promovendo alinhamento e antecipação de riscos.
  • Suportar a estruturação fiscal de novos contratos, operações e projetos — especialmente no setor de energias renováveis (geração, comercialização de energia, incentivos regionais, etc.).
  • Gerenciar, desenvolver e capacitar a equipe fiscal, promovendo atualização técnica contínua e boas práticas.
  • Criar, revisar e atualizar procedimentos da área.
  • Reportar indicadores tributários de compliance.

  • Manter-se atualizado diante de todas as alterações legislativas pertinentes ao setor e à área tributária.
  • Mapear novas oportunidades, otimizações dos processos fiscais e eventuais riscos fiscais.
  • Apoiar nas previsões orçamentárias da área.

A Clubbi é um marketplace B2B para pequenos mercados de bairro. Fornecemos uma nova forma de abastecer a loja: mais conveniente, aos melhores preços e com os melhores prazos de entrega.

Nossa visão é otimizar toda a cadeia de suprimentos e operações para este segmento do varejo, que representa um mercado de R$250Bi somente no Brasil.

A Clubbi foi fundada em 2020 e já chamou atenção de alguns dos melhores fundos de VC do Brasil e do Vale do Silício: Valor Capital, OneVC, Canary, Better Tomorrow Ventures.

Em 2022, recebemos a rodada Series A, liderada por Hi Ventures e Nfx.

Nossa Cultura e Valores

Nossa missão é fortalecer os pequenos varejistas como os maiores protagonistas do comércio na América Latina.

A gente acredita que por meio da digitalização de toda a cadeia de suprimentos e das operações do varejo podemos nos transformar no canal mais eficiente de distribuição para estes produtos.

Para ter sucesso neste objetivo, desenvolvemos uma cultura única e especial:

  • Nos desprendemos da nossa realidade para vestir a camisa pelo nosso cliente;
  • Desenvolvemos um time fora da curva;

  • Cuidamos para que a Clubbi seja um local incrível para trabalhar;

Missão do Cargo

Num contexto de forte crescimento das vendas, gerenciar nossa frota agregada, assegurando profissionalismo, eficiência e disponibilidade dos motoristas.

A área de transporte tem um papel essencial dentro da Clubbi, impactando a experiência dos nossos clientes no momento da entrega, e garantindo nosso crescimento por meio da captação e desenvolvimento de novos motoristas.

A área de transporte também é responsável pelo transporte first mile, dos nossos fornecedores até o nosso armazém.

Gestão de transportadores (First Mile)

Gestão da frota agregada

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
MSF has worked in Brazil for over 30 years in a context of deep social inequalities and unequal access to healthcare. Since 2018, MSF Operational Centre Brussels (OCB) has implemented direct operations, initially supporting migrants and refugees, and later expanding to Indigenous health, emergency response, and public health.

In 2026, the programme focuses on the Rio de Janeiro Tuberculosis Prison Project, improving access to TB care for people deprived of liberty, while maintaining engagement in emergency preparedness, advocacy, and institutional collaboration with MSF Brazil and regional referents.

The programme operates within a shared institutional setup with MSF Brazil and Cell 5 (Latin America & Caribbean), requiring strong coordination and compliance with OCB standards. To support this environment, MSF OCB is recruiting a Human Resources Coordinator (HRCo).

As HRCo , you oversee HR strategy and policy implementation across the programme, ensure alignment with operational needs and OCB standards, act as a strategic partner to operations, and are fully accountable for MSF’s employer responsibilities, including legal and compliance matters.

Responsibilities

1. Strategic HR Leadership & Workforce Planning

  • Translate programme priorities (TB Prison Project, emergency preparedness, advocacy) into short-, mid-, and long-term workforce strategies.
  • Adapt the Coordination Team structure to a single-project programme, clarifying roles, reporting lines, and decision‑making.
  • Ensure HR systems support the transition from multiple projects (Marajó, Yanomami) to Rio TB Prison Project.
  • Anticipate emergency and future staffing needs through scenario planning, surge mechanisms, and training plans.

2. Recruitment, Matching & Talent Management

  • Define HR needs and coordinate recruitment and IMS matching in compliance with Brazilian labour law (CLT) and OCB policies.
  • Manage a diverse workforce (country‑based and mobile staff), including operational constraints such as Portuguese language requirements.
  • Analyse the labour market, define recruitment strategies, and identify effective sourcing channels.
  • Maintain an emergency pool to ensure rapid mobilisation capacity.
  • Promote internal and interprogramme mobility through a programme‑specific mobility approach aligned with MSF standards.

3. Governance, Compliance & Institutional Coordination

  • Ensure coherent HR governance within a shared institutional setup (OCB, MSF Brazil, Cell 5).
  • Coordinate closely with MSF Brazil on legal matters, audits, payroll, benefits, HR systems, and outsourced services.
  • Ensure full compliance of HR policies, contracts, and procedures with Brazilian legislation and MSF standards.
  • Guarantee accurate documentation, HR data quality, system use, monthly closing, and HR reporting.
  • Define, adapt, and implement local HR policies, SOPs, and guidelines in line with MSF frameworks.
  • Oversee induction, training, performance management (PMS), and career development.
  • Identify training and development needs, including high‑potential staff, aligned with future programme priorities.
  • Integrate safeguarding, behaviour & ethics, and diversity & inclusion across the HR lifecycle.
  • Define and coordinate a fair, competitive, and compliant reward policy.

5. Support Operations & People Management

  • Provide HR analysis and workforce planning for the TB Prison Project, including scale‑up and technical specialisation.
  • Ensure HR operational support during emergencies (recruitment, deployment, contracts, health and safety, administration).
  • Advise on HR aspects of advocacy initiatives, including contractual and legal considerations.
  • Coach managers on people management, communication, conflict management, and stress prevention.
  • Prevent, detect, and manage conflicts and behavioural issues.

6. Team Leadership, Administration & Duty of Care

  • Act as programme‑level HR and Administration technical referent.
  • Line‑manage the HR and administration team.
  • Ensure structured staff lifecycle processes (briefings, induction, end of assignment, debriefing, knowledge capitalisation).
  • Ensure safe, healthy, and compliant working conditions in coordination with medical and logistics teams.

7. Coordination, Representation & Strategic Contribution

  • Contribute actively to Country Coordination Team decision‑making and strategic planning.
  • Plan, monitor, and report on HR operational and budgetary needs.
  • Report on HR indicators to support programme adjustments and strategic decisions.
  • Represent MSF with authorities and external stakeholders on HR and administrative matters.
  • Contribute to the long‑term alignment and harmonisation of practices between OCB and MSF Brazil.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Degree in HR management or related administrative studies is mandatory.
  • Minimum 3 years of HR management experience with MSF or a similar INGO is mandatory.
  • Minimum 6 months of international MSF experience as HR Coordinator is mandatory.
  • Experience in mediation and conflict management is mandatory.
  • Experience in training, coaching, mentoring, and team supervision is mandatory.
  • Experience in emergency contexts is an asset.
  • Knowledge of the Brazilian legal framework is an asset.
  • Knowledge of MSF OCB internal HR tools is an asset.

Languages

  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese , both written & spoken is mandatory.

Conditions

  • Expected starting date: As soon as possible.
  • Location: based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
  • Salary according to MSF salary grid.
  • The contractual terms, conditions and salary will be established according to the official residence of the selected candidate (mobile staff contract if not resident in Brazil, local contract otherwise).
  • Family position possible.

MSF values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of disability, gender identity, marital or civil partnership status, race, color or ethnic and national origins, religion or belief, or sexual orientation.

title: Field Service Mechanical Engineer
description:
Join the Baker Hughes – Americas BRUSH Team to carry out on-site installation service maintenance, alignment, cleaning, repair and modification of large high voltage generators, motors and sync condensers.

Responsibilities

  • Mechanical Generator inspection, maintenance and repair in line with OEM standards and processes.
  • Strip down and rebuild large generators and related equipment; fault find and rectify as necessary and overhaul and clean.
  • Installation and commissioning of large turbo‑driven generators, sync condensers, and motors.
  • Carrying out mechanical alignment checks, basic electrical tests and adjustments to machines and complex shaft systems using mechanical, optical and laser‑based systems including electrical test equipment.
  • Interpret specifications and technical requirements; prepare method statements and detailed, concise reports for submission to customers. Attend technical meetings on site and at customers' premises.
  • Undergo training if necessary to ensure assistance to winding specialists in carrying out in‑situ winding repairs/rewinds is provided.
  • The job description is not to be regarded as exclusive or exhaustive and you may be required to undertake various duties as may reasonably be required of you by the Company to provide solutions for customers.

Qualifications

  • Have an accredited mechanical or electrical engineering qualification or relevant experience at minimum, qualified through a recognized craft apprenticeship in fitting and assembly operations on large high voltage rotating electrical machines.
  • Have mechanical experience working on motors and/or generators.
  • Be self‑sufficient, resourceful and a problem solver.
  • Have strength of character and high levels of energy.
  • Be an effective communicator, fluent in both spoken and written English.
  • Be able to undertake overseas and offshore assignments, in addition to attending trainings in Italy, the UK and Czech Republic.
  • Have experience dealing with external stakeholders on‑site and operating remotely on own initiative.
  • Have knowledge of concepts, practices and procedures of health, safety & environment (HSE) and be willing to be a leader in HSE.
  • Be a good team player with the ability to work independently.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programmes
  • Tailored financial programmes

Nossos papéis na Operação

Nossa equipe é o motor da nossa operação . É ela que garante a melhor experiência ao cliente, a agilidade no serviço e um ambiente acolhedor, seguro e inclusivo.

No Grupo FIT, acreditamos que cada talento tem sua própria potência . Por isso, as funções podem ser ajustadas conforme o perfil, as habilidades e as necessidades de cada pessoa — aqui, o importante é fazer o time avançar.

As posições que mantêm nossa operação acelerando são:

  • Hostess: A largada perfeita da jornada do cliente. Você será responsável por recepcionar, organizar o fluxo de mesas e garantir uma primeira impressão calorosa e eficiente.
  • Garçom: O piloto do atendimento. Você atuará no contato direto com o cliente, apresentando o cardápio, acompanhando pedidos e garantindo uma experiência fluida e de alta qualidade.
  • Cumim: O apoio estratégico da pista. Você dará suporte ao salão, ajudando na organização, limpeza das mesas e agilidade no atendimento.
  • Cozinheiro: O engenheiro dos sabores. Você será responsável pelo preparo dos pratos, seguindo padrões de qualidade, segurança alimentar e excelência na execução.
  • Auxiliar de Cozinha: O reforço essencial da equipe técnica. Você apoiará no pré-preparo, organização do espaço e manutenção do ritmo da cozinha.
  • Pizzaiolo: O especialista em performance artesanal. Você cuidará da massa, montagem e finalização das pizzas, garantindo consistência, sabor e alto padrão de entrega.
  • Sushiman: O mestre da precisão. Você será responsável pela preparação e montagem dos pratos da culinária japonesa, com atenção aos detalhes e apresentação impecável.
  • Operador de Caixa: A bandeirada final da experiência. Você atuará no registro de pedidos, atendimento no caixa e fechamento de contas com agilidade e responsabilidade.

O que Esperamos de Você

  • Foco em performance: Disposição para aprender, crescer e contribuir para os resultados do time.
  • Experiência do cliente: Garantir um atendimento cordial, ágil e alinhado ao nosso padrão de excelência.
  • Ritmo de operação: Apoiar as rotinas diárias do salão, cozinha, atendimento ou áreas administrativas, mantendo a operação em movimento.
  • Padrões de qualidade: Seguir nossos protocolos de higiene, segurança e qualidade para manter a alta performance da equipe.
  • Trabalho em equipe: Jogar junto, colaborar e fortalecer o time para cruzarmos a linha de chegada com excelência.
  • Cuidado com a sua área: Manter organização, zelo com equipamentos e responsabilidade com o espaço de trabalho.

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos um profissional que se identifique com nosso propósito e tenha as seguintes qualificações:

  • Organizacionais: Disciplina que nos fortalece, Segurança em cada atitude, Gratidão que nos conecta, Vibração que inspira.
  • Habilidades: Proatividade, agilidade, atenção aos detalhes e disposição para contribuir em diferentes funções operacionais.
  • Comportamentais: Espírito de equipe, comprometimento, resiliência e vontade de acelerar no desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Conhecimentos: Escolaridade a partir do ensino fundamental completo, de acordo com a vaga escolhida; disponibilidade para atuar em escalas operacionais e flexibilidade de horários.
  • Vivência desejável: Experiência prévia em áreas como atendimento, cozinha ou funções similares será um diferencial no grid de largada.

Basic Function

The Contracts and Subaward Specialist will support the Research Institute for Tactical Autonomy (RITA) by providing comprehensive pre‑and post‑award administrative oversight of the program. This role is pivotal to the operational success of RITA’s University Affiliated Research Center (UARC) by ensuring effective compliance coordination, administrative efficiency, and overall alignment with federal research administration best practices, particularly those relevant to Department of War (DoW) sponsors.

Pre‑Award

  • Guide RITA‑affiliated investigators from multiple academic institutions in the submission of proposals, including budgets, narratives, and sponsor forms.

  • Collaborate with faculty to interpret UARC‑specific proposal requirements and address any sponsor‑specific issues early in the process.

Post‑Award

  • Support award setup, budget alignment, and personnel onboarding in coordination with relevant offices.
  • Prepare budget revisions as needed, submit them for approval, and process them in Cayuse or other relevant university systems. Monitor expenditures for allowability, allocability, and adherence to DoW regulations and institutional policy.
  • Reconcile subrecipient invoices to ensure personnel charges are approved, and non‑personnel expenditures are allowed under the approved budget.
  • Route travel, materials and supplies, equipment, and financial aid requests for approval and ensure the expenditures are allowed under the approved budget.Prepare and track project reports, ensuring timely submission of technical and financial deliverables in line with CDRLs.
  • Provide monthly financial performance reports to investigators to ensure alignment with spending/projection plans.

Compliance & Strategic Coordination

  • Ensure consistent interpretation and application of research administration policies and DoW‑specific requirements, including export controls and CUI protocols.
  • Serve as a RITA liaison with central compliance to proactively resolve administrative issues.
  • Maintain awareness of FAR/DFARS updates and research security guidance relevant to the UARC mission.

Training & Development

  • Provide onboarding and training to RITA‑affiliated PIs and staff on research administration processes.
  • Participate in policy discussions and contribute to continuous process improvement across the RITA administrative infrastructure.

Core Competencies

  • Strong understanding of the full research administration lifecycle (pre‑ and post‑award).
  • Experience with federal grants and cooperative agreements, especially from DoW (e.g., AFOSR, DARPA).
  • Familiarity with FAR, DFARS, CUI guidelines, and federal acquisition standards.
  • Ability to manage competing deadlines, coordinate across stakeholders, and communicate clearly with diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in research administration systems (Cayuse, Workday, or similar).
  • Comfort with iterative approaches and adapting plans as new information emerges.
  • Self‑starter who can operate with minimal direction.
  • Incumbent must have knowledge of the budget cycle process.
  • Ability to prepare comprehensive, complex financial and budget reports using Excel.
  • Proficiency in MS Office.

Minimum Requirements

  • BA, BBA, or BS (or higher) in Business, Finance, Public Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in research administration, preferably in a university or UARC/FFRDC environment.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex, multi‑institutional research programs.
  • U.S. citizenship is required due to federal export control and security compliance requirements.

This position reflects an embedded administrative support role.

Descrição da vaga

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Planejar, organizar, controlar e avaliar as atividades da área de Tecnologia da Informação, aperfeiçoando sistemas, rotinas, procedimentos e métodos administrativos, visando o cumprimento das atividades técnicas, administrativas e procedimentos internos.

  • Acompanhar o cumprimento da Política de Segurança da Informação definida para a instituição, a fim de garantir um melhor aproveitamento dos recursos computacionais;

Job description

Hostess, Garçom, Cumim, Cozinheiro... Sua vaga está no nosso radar!

Você é o coração da operação. É a sua energia que faz com que cada cliente tenha uma experiência inesquecível no Grupo FIT.

Se você trabalha na operação do restaurante , seja como Hostess, Garçom, Cumim, Cozinheiro, ou em outras posições do time , e tem o perfil para fazer a operação acontecer com agilidade, foco no cliente e espírito de equipe, queremos você no nosso time!

Esta não é uma vaga para uma posição específica, mas a sua chance de se conectar com a gente. Ao se cadastrar no nosso Banco de Talentos para Operações , você garante um lugar em nosso time para futuras oportunidades.

Main responsibilities

Nossos papéis na Operação

Nossa equipe é a essência do nosso negócio. É nela que garantimos o atendimento de excelência, a agilidade no serviço e o ambiente acolhedor. As posições que mantêm nossa operação funcionando são:

  • Hostess: A primeira impressão do cliente. Você irá recebê-lo com cordialidade e organizará o fluxo de mesas, garantindo uma recepção calorosa e ágil.
  • Garçom: O elo com o cliente. Você será responsável por servir mesas, apresentar o cardápio e garantir que os pedidos sejam entregues com precisão e simpatia.
  • Cumim: O braço direito do salão. Você será responsável por dar suporte aos garçons, ajudando na limpeza das mesas, na organização do salão e no transporte dos pedidos.
  • Cozinheiro: O artista principal da cozinha quente. Você será responsável por executar e preparar os pratos do cardápio principal, seguindo as receitas e os padrões de qualidade e higiene da empresa.
  • Auxiliar de Cozinha: O suporte essencial para a equipe da cozinha. Você será responsável por auxiliar no pré-preparo dos ingredientes, na organização do espaço e na limpeza, garantindo que tudo flua com perfeição para o time de cozinheiros.
  • Pizzaiolo: O especialista no preparo das nossas pizzas. Você será responsável por manusear a massa, montar e assar as pizzas de forma artesanal, garantindo que o produto final seja sempre de altíssima qualidade.
  • Sushiman: O mestre da culinária japonesa. Você será responsável por preparar e montar os sushis, sashimis e outros pratos do menu, com atenção aos detalhes e à apresentação impecável.
  • Operador de Caixa: A finalização perfeita da experiência. Você cuidará de todas as transações, garantindo agilidade e precisão no fechamento das contas

O que Esperamos de Você

  • Foco em resultados: Ter um perfil proativo e com mentalidade de vendas para contribuir ativamente para o aumento do nosso lucro e o sucesso da equipe.
  • Atendimento ao cliente: Garantir um serviço ágil e cordial, sempre com foco total na experiência do cliente.
  • Apoio na operação: Colaborar nas rotinas diárias, garantindo a fluidez da operação no salão, cozinha, atendimento e caixa.
  • Padrões de qualidade: Seguir nossos protocolos de qualidade, higiene e segurança para manter a excelência em tudo que fazemos.
  • Trabalho em equipe: Atuar de forma colaborativa e coesa, apoiando seus colegas para que juntos alcancem as metas.
  • Cuidado com a sua área: Manter a organização e o cuidado com equipamentos e utensílios de trabalho

Requirements and skills

Buscamos um profissional que se identifique com nosso propósito e tenha as seguintes qualificações:

  • Organizacionais: Disciplina que nos fortalece, Segurança em cada atitude, Gratidão que nos conecta, Vibração que inspira.
  • Habilidades: Proatividade, agilidade, atenção aos detalhes e disposição para contribuir em diferentes funções operacionais.
  • Comportamentais: Espírito de equipe, comprometimento, resiliência e vontade de acelerar no desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Conhecimentos: Escolaridade a partir do ensino fundamental completo, de acordo com a vaga escolhida; disponibilidade para atuar em escalas operacionais e flexibilidade de horários.
  • Vivência desejável: Experiência prévia em áreas como atendimento, cozinha ou funções similares será um diferencial no grid de largada.

Additional information

Local de Atuação: Lojas do Grupo FIT no terminal Gentileza

Remuneração: Salário compatívelcom o mercado;

Gorjeta atrativa: Nossas gorjetas são um grande diferencial, refletindo o seu esforço e a alta performance do nosso time;

Refeição no local;

Vale transporte.

Escala: 6x1 (1 folga semanal + 1 domingo/mês).

Turnos disponíveis:

  • Manhã: 06h às 14h20
  • Tarde: 14h às 22h20
  • Noite: 22h às 06h20 (Conforme a operação da loja)

description:
Descrição da vaga

Quem Somos

Somos um time que cuida da limpeza do seu lar gerando bem-estar, no qual combinamos determinação e comprometimento para entregarmos produtos de qualidade.

Entendemos que para obter os melhores resultados, precisamos dos melhores profissionais.

Se você tem prazer em contribuir, gosta do que faz e é focado em resultados, essa VAGA é para VOCÊ

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Missão: Estruturar e sustentar o sistema de gestão de performance operacional (processos, indicadores e melhoria contínua), garantindo execução de iniciativas e captura de valor em custo, serviço, produtividade e capital.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Mapear processos ponta a ponta e definir padrões operacionais, SLAs e controles de rotina.
  • Estruturar e manter governança de KPIs (definições, fontes, consistência) e dashboards industriais e logísticos.
  • Conduzir rituais de performance (DMS) e gestão de planos de ação, com escalonamento e acompanhamento de prazos.
  • Liderar projetos de melhoria contínua (Lean/DMAIC), realizando análise de causa-raiz e implantando soluções com plano de controle.
  • Medir perdas e oportunidades (OEE, refugo, retrabalho, avarias, OTIF, produtividade, custo logístico) e propor iniciativas.
  • Mensurar ganhos benefits tracking (baseline, metas, ganhos) em parceria com Finanças e Operações: CAPEX desprendido + OPEX incremental à Payback e ROI de projetos.
  • Capacitar times operacionais em ferramentas e rotinas (PDCA, 5W2H, Ishikawa, VSM, 5S) e apoiar gestão da mudança.
  • Atuar como ponte entre Operações, Logística e Finanças para priorização e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Para você fazer parte do nosso Grupo de talentos, você precisa ter:

  • Formação: Engenharia e correlatas (preferencialmente, Eng. Mecânica, Química, Produção ou Adm.)
  • Domínio de indicadores operacionais (OEE, OTIF, produtividade, perdas, inventário).
  • Excel/Power BI (ou similar) para análise e automação de relatórios.
  • Vivência em Lean/Six Sigma (desejável Green Belt).
  • Experiência em indústria e/ou logística com foco em performance e processos.
  • Atuar de 100% presencial em nossas unidades de negócio (Botafogo, Pavuna e Queimados).

Indicadores de sucesso (exemplos)

  • Redução de perdas (refugo, retrabalho, avarias, urgências/fretes extras).
  • Aumento de produtividade e eficiência (OEE, unidades/hora, picking/hora).
  • Melhoria de nível de serviço (OTIF, lead time, backlog).
  • Aderência a padrão e disciplina de rotina (reuniões, planos de ação, SLA de dados).
  • Ganhos validados (R$) e sustentados (control plan).

description:
Coordinator, Competition

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the FIFA27 Senior Competition Manager, the Competition Coordinator will be a key member of the FIFA27 Competition Management (CPM) team. Working closely with and under the guidance of the FIFA Competition Management project team, the role is responsible for delivering the highest standards of competition, tournament and match operations in Brazil before and during the FWWC27, as well as for FIFA test events and other relevant tournaments and events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure that competition area and venue readiness are implemented in line with FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines, under the guidance of FIFA Competition Management, the Senior Competition Manager and the Competition Manager.
  • Support the planning, training, administration and integration of the locally based Competition Management team.
  • Together with the Senior Competition Manager and the Competition Manager, oversee the successful operational delivery of Competition Management activities before and during the FWWC27.
  • Represent Competition Management at key meetings, inspections and operational forums as required.
  • Collating feedback and building presentations based on strategic meetings and site inspections.
  • Plan and deliver competition-related events, workshops and seminars in collaboration with FIFA Zurich (including test events and official FIFA workshops).
  • Monitor competition areas during venue construction or refurbishment to ensure compliance with FIFA standards and follow up on all related requirements.
  • Plan and deliver stadium and competition readiness exercises, including development of operational documentation and materials.
  • Oversee team and stadium equipment requirements (e.g. team materials, field of play equipment), including procurement coordination, delivery and confirmation.
  • Preparing reports and presentations on Competition Management key matters.
  • Support the recruitment, training and coordination of Competition Management volunteers.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor's degree in Sports Management or Event Management (master’s degree is an asset).
  • Minimum 2 (two) years of experience in football and event management; international experience is preferred.
  • At least 1 (one) year of experience in Competition Management (football and match operations).
  • Strong knowledge of international football.
  • Proven experience in competition and match operations, as well as sports venue operations.
  • Solid understanding of event planning, project management, and logistics processes.
  • Knowledge of the local culture and operational environment in Brazil is an advantage.
  • Strong administrative and IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Ability to monitor performance and implement decisive corrective actions.
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain highly qualified employees.

title: HSS and Signalling Engineer - São Paulo/Rio de Janeiro Based
description:
Overview

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. The company operates a fully regulated telecommunications platform across 40 countries worldwide, including its own global mobile core network, in-house eSIM technology, and a broad portfolio of telecom licenses.

We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast-moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund growth and continue investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion.

Founded in 2022 by technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in 28 additional markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Signalling functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analyzing and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the signalling routing area and subscriber data management systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes for the existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support other functional areas in cross-functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLDs, LLDs, WOs, etc.) and maintaining it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environments. Understanding of end-to-end system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers and service providers
  • Elaborate and manage the process for change requests to current partners to meet network needs
  • Control the network elements roadmap, responsible for necessary software/hardware upgrades during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including cross-team processes
  • Document the existing technology portfolio and propose recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

Must-haves

  • Proven experience in implementing live mobile telecom solutions (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), network design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of signalling network functions, including STPs, DEA/DRAs and HLR/HSS
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining signalling interconnects (SIGTRAN and DIAMETER) using SCTP multi-homing
  • Experience with HLR/HSS, subscriber profiles, subscriber repositories and reference interfaces
  • Knowledge of IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes, including Application Servers and its interaction with profile repositories
  • Experience in mobile services charging (online). Knowledge and experience with Ro, Gy, Gx interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with signalling protocols and routing including M3UA, M2PA, DIAMETER, as well as upper layer protocols such as MAP, CAMEL, Sh, Cx
  • Knowledge of 5G SA networks from a signalling (SCP and SEPP) and AUSF/UDM/UDR perspective
  • Experience with protocol analyser tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architectures and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory; other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • +3 years working in telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, HPE products

Benefits

What We Offer?

  • CLT contract — job stability and reliable benefits
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: Collaborate daily with management and external advisors, exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where ideas are heard and open dialogue is encouraged
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency and impact

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer and we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Reporting organizationally to the FIFA27 Senior Competition Manager, the Competition Coordinator will be a key member of the FIFA27 Competition Management (CPM) team.   • Bachelor's degree in Sports Management or Event Management (master’s degree is an asset).

  • Solid understanding of event planning, project management, and logistics processes.

  • Ability to prioritize and handle large workload efficiently at peak times.
  • Ability to work under pressure and stress.
  • Sound judgement and prioritization of tasks.
  • Experience of managing multi‑disciplined teams across a variety of business areas.
  • Team Player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Ability to work effectively in an international, dynamic and demanding environment.
  • Ability to adapt and work with people from different cultures and backgrounds.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken); any additional language skills (in particular Spanish and French) are an asset.

title: Manager, Access Management Cluster
description:
Manager, Access Management Cluster

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN´S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brazil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures.

Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well‑planned ingress, circulation & egress.

The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament.

You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites.
  • Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution.
  • Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings.
  • Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements onsite and assist all client groups with any access related issues.
  • Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions.
  • Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them.

Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar.
  • If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply.
  • Football access management knowledge.
  • FIFA access management knowledge is a plus.
  • Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues.
  • Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people.

Experience

  • Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage.
  • Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation.
  • Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment.
  • Single‑sport, multi‑venue event experience.
  • Management and leadership of a team in high‑pressure tournament operations.
  • Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

This position is to work on a hybrid schedule in our office in Rio de Janeiro.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed in a timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and in a timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIs.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work‑life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires).
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Airswift, we believe that diversity is critical to our success and makes us a great place to work. We are committed to building an equal opportunity workplace, the more inclusive we are - the better our work will be.

description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

A successful alumni relations program depends on a robust strategy to build lasting relationships with alumni and ensure their continued engagement and support. The Assistant Director, Alumni Programs, focuses on developing and implementing centralized engagement initiatives and programs to support the alumni community at Howard University. This role is a key driver in fostering a lifelong connection between the University and its alumni population through educational, professional development, and networking opportunities.

Supervisory Authority

This position will have supervisory authority over the Manager for Career and Professional Development Manager and the Manager for Reunion Programs. The Assistant Director provides leadership, direction, coaching, performance management, and professional development for these positions; establishes annual goals and priorities; and ensures alignment across program portfolios.

Nature And Scope

Reporting to the Director of Alumni Relations, this position oversees strategies and long-term projects that aim to cultivate a strong, supportive, and engaged alumni network. The Assistant Director will be a key driver in the growth of centralized alumni engagement through programs, outreach, and volunteer development. This role works closely with the Director of Alumni Relations to develop sustainable alumni programs and execute priorities and will serve as a liaison for internal and external stakeholders, representing the Alumni Relations team through various forms of communication. The position requires collaboration with various campus partners, including the career services and development teams, to ensure alignment of efforts and to promote philanthropic support from alumni. This role is also responsible for overseeing career development opportunities and reunions.

Principal Accountabilities

  • The Assistant Director, Alumni Programs, is responsible for the day-to-day operation of long-term alumni programs, focusing on centralized, non-geographical initiatives.
  • This includes planning, developing, and executing programs that provide career readiness and professional development for alumni.
  • The role will manage platforms and projects that facilitate alumni mentorship and networking.
  • The position is accountable for overseeing the planning and execution of all alumni reunions and reunion staff roles.
  • Additionally, the position works alongside the campus partners like the Office of the Secretary, Center for Career and Professional Success, and the Ralphe Bunche Center.
  • A key responsibility includes developing and disseminating engaging content through various channels, including newsletters, social media, and online communities, to keep alumni informed and connected.
  • The Assistant Director will also track and analyze alumni engagement metrics and use this data to inform future strategies and improve programs.
  • The role also involves collaborating with leadership to identify and recognize alumni contributions through programs and events.
  • This position will support efforts to maintain an up-to-date alumni database and provide reports to university stakeholders as requested.

Core Competencies

  • Proven experience in planning and executing large-scale events and multi-channel engagement strategies.
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse constituencies.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency in relevant technologies, including alumni databases (e.g., Raiser’s Edge), event management tools, PeopleGrove, and social media.
  • Ability to work comfortably and effectively both independently and in group scenarios.
  • A belief in and ability to articulate the university's mission and the importance of alumni engagement.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field such as business, marketing, or communications. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in alumni relations, event management, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience working with various software programs for engagement, including marketing platforms, event platforms, or CRM systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed for events or meetings

Expected Salary range: $75,000 - $85,000

Job Description

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

UNDP provides integrated programmatic, policy and financing solutions to realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). In this context, UNDP has created a Global Policy Network (GPN), a network of field-based and global technical expertise across a wide range of knowledge domains and in support of the signature solutions and organizational capabilities envisioned in the Strategic Plan. The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) and the Crisis Bureau (CB) are the two anchor Bureaux of the GPN.

In this context, the newly established Governance, Rule of Law, and Peacebuilding (GRP) Hub, a joint endeavor with the Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS), provides leadership and advisory services to enhance UNDP’s impact on governance and peacebuilding, ensuring the integration of democratic governance and human rights into crisis response and recovery.

Through Local Action, the GRP Hub seeks to contribute to peace and development, achieving a visible impact on communities and improving lives by delivering integrated solutions that harness global expertise and partnerships. The Local Action Unit works closely with local and regional governments as key development players, highlighting their role as public service implementers, as drivers of innovation and the closest institution to people.

Local and regional governments are already responsible for over 65% of the SDG targets, most of them linked to basic service provision from water, sanitation, mobility, climate action, health or education. Cities and territories are playing a big part in the implementation of SDGs, becoming a tool for strategic planning and budgeting in the mid to long term. Since 2015, local governments and their associations have been active in promoting the SDGs through advocacy, working with their local population and partners in transposing the spirit of Agenda 2030 in cities and territories. Local Governments have also started to use SDGs as a framework to deliver better public services linked to SDG targets and indicators. As part of the SDG Local Action project, UNDP is one of the implementing partners of the Mayors Challenge, a global initiative to reimagine essential services that cities deliver to residents.

Duties And Responsibilities

Under the overall supervision of the Project Manager and in close coordination with IplanRio, relevant municipal technical teams, and UNDP, the Tech Lead Analyst, Software Engineering and Data Science will perform the following functions:

  • Lead data engineering and integration
  • Lead the modeling, integration, and transformation of data from multiple municipal secretariats into the Integrated Municipal Registry (RMI)
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of reproducible, scalable, and well-documented data pipelines
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, traceability, and governance across project data assets
  • Guide technical decisions related to data architecture and interoperability
  • Lead analytical and machine learning development
  • Lead the development of analytical and machine learning models to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities relevant to public service delivery
  • Oversee exploratory data analysis and validation processes to generate actionable insights
  • Ensure appropriate model testing, monitoring, and refinement over time
  • Apply and promote the use of model interpretability techniques, where relevant
  • Support product development and decision-making
  • Translate analytical results into practical recommendations and data products for public policy use
  • Work closely with technical teams and sectoral teams to align solutions with operational and policy needs
  • Contribute to the design of proactive communication and service delivery mechanisms informed by data
  • Ensure technical standards, sustainability and knowledge management
  • Establish and promote best practices for versioning, documentation, reproducibility, and code quality
  • Contribute to the definition of technical standards, architecture, and implementation approaches for the project
  • Support the long-term sustainability, maintainability, and scalability of the solution
  • Provide technical guidance to other team members and facilitate collaboration across disciplines

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the project.

Institutional Arrangements

The Tech Lead Analyst will act in close coordination with the Project manager, allocated at IplanRio, municipal technical teams from the City Hall, including the relevant teams from Health, Education, and Social Assistance, and UNDP, contributing to the technical implementation of the project.

The Analyst will report to the Advisor, cities and local governments based in UNDP HQ in New York, USA.

  • Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 2: Facilitate conversations to bridge differences, considers in decision making.

  • Business Management: Working with Evidence and Data – Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions and supporting decision-making.
  • Business Direction & Strategy: System Thinking – Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system.
  • Digital: Data engineering – Ability in programming languages such as SQL, Python, and R, be adept at finding warehousing solutions, and using ETL tools, and understanding basic machine learning and algorithms.
  • Digital: Data governance – Knowledge of data science, skills to develop data management tools, organize and maintain databases and operate data visualization technologies.

Design data warehouses, data lakes or data platforms concepts. Education

  • A first-level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the above-mentioned fields, in combination with an additional two (2) years of qualifying experience, will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Experience

Qualifications

Responsibilities

Habilidades:

Comunica de modo eficiente - Desenvolve e transmite comunicação de diversas maneiras, de forma a transmitir um entendimento claro das necessidades particulares de diferentes públicos.

Foco no cliente - Constrói relações sólidas com os clientes e fornece soluções orientadas aos mesmos.

Desenvolve talento - Desenvolve pessoas para atender tanto aos objetivos de carreira delas, como também os objetivos da empresa.

Gerencia complexidade - Consegue dar sentido a informações complexas, extensas e às vezes contraditórias para resolver problemas de maneira eficiente.

Autodesenvolvimento - Procura ativamente novas maneiras de crescer e ser desafiado usando canais de desenvolvimento formais e informais.

Fundamentos de saúde e segurança - Defende e modela comportamentos proativos de saúde e segurança por meio da identificação, notificação e participação em ações que buscam melhorar a saúde e a segurança a fim de construir uma cultura interdependente e contribuir para um local de trabalho sem lesões.

Aplicação de diagnósticos - Traduz reclamações de clientes p/ desenvolver plano de solução de problemas; soluciona problemas após fluxos de trabalho guiados, procedim., equips. especializados, como ferram. de serv. mec. e eletrôn., e diagnostica soft. de comput. p/ isolar compon. com falha p/ permitir um reparo bem-sucedido; valida a reparação duplicando a reclamação para garantir sua resolução; documenta result. de solução de problemas em sist. de negócios para comunicar o que foi feito p/ pagto. e rastreamento histórico.

Aplicação de ferramenta de serviço eletrônico - Identifica o conjunto de ferramentas de hardware e software necessárias para um evento de serviço; usa o conjunto de ferramentas eletrônicas apropriado para manter o produto ou diagnosticar e solucionar um problema; interpreta resultados de ferramentas eletrônicas ou recomendações para determinar os próximos passos para a resolução de serviços.

Interações de sistemas de motor - Interpretação e análise de interações de sistemas mecânicos e elétricos internos e externos (escapamento, aquecimento, resfriamento, sistemas de combustível, transmissão, pós-tratamento, controles, sensores etc.) através da aplicação de ferramentas, de publicações de serviço (Cummins, Fabricantes de Equipamentos Originais) e da adoção de medidas para a elaboração de diagnóstico e reparo de equipamentos de forma correta e eficiente.

Manutenção e Reparo de Produtos - Cons. e real. man. em prod. elétr/mec. seguindo instr., utilizando as ferr. nec. de acordo com o temp. de reparo padr. para garantir um cons. de qualidade; mont. e desm. de motores ou ger. de energia seguindo instr., usando as ferr. necessárias para gar. um amb. limpo e org.; ver. e subs. de peças e comp. seguindo as instr. de reutilização para min. os custos de propriedade dos clientes; realiza verificação de dano progressivo seguindo diretrizes para restauração à condição antes da falha.

Documentação de serviço - Cria e verifica clientes, equipamentos e informações técnicas; captura dados específicos usando ferramentas de serviço necessárias; segue os procedimentos e documentos exigidos no sistema de gerenciamento de serviços, a fim de ter um registro preciso do trabalho realizado.

Escalonamento técnico - Obtém informações sobre problemas técnicos do produto e usa recursos disponíveis, incluindo ferramentas de gerenciamento de dados; eleva os problemas a um nível mais alto de especialização, equilibrando a oportunidade da resposta do cliente com os esforços de investigação; captura todas as etapas de solução de problemas no banco de dados apropriado para garantir transições contínuas e respostas precisas à resolução de tickets em tempo hábil.

Valoriza diferenças - Reconhece o valor que diferentes perspectivas e culturas trazem para a empresa.
